name: ringer_break
_: HANDOFF-KEEPSIES 4.1 redefines this gate. A 4.0 m/s clean snap through the centre mib, aim jitter half a degree, seeds 1 to 200: mibs out in [1,3] on at least 80 percent of shots, everything asleep by 8 seconds on 100 percent. The taw staying inside is NOT this gate; it is reported. The design's 3.5 m/s knocks nothing out at any tested setting.

asserts.id: a break puts 1 to 3 mibs out
the taw staying in is measured, not required
how long a shot takes to settle

_floor: Thirty metres each way. A mib struck by a six metre per second taw leaves at nearly eight, and on a ten metre floor it used to roll off the edge and fall for ever, which quietly poisoned both the sleep measurement and the fingerprint.
